rows.grounds: compound of māṇikya (ruby), mukuṭa (crown), and upeta (endowed with); describes the deity as bearing a ruby crown
compound of ratna (jewel), ābharaṇa (ornament), and bhūṣita (decorated); describes the deity as adorned with jeweled ornaments

items.question: What specific crown and ornaments adorn the contemplated deity?
premises: The contemplated deity is endowed with a ruby crown.
The contemplated deity is decorated with jewel ornaments.
These adornments form part of the deity's visualized appearance.
items.inference: The worshipped deity is to be visualized as richly adorned with a ruby crown and jeweled ornaments.
items.plain_english: I worship him who is adorned with a ruby crown and decorated with jeweled ornaments.
